node.statement: For the successor raw call u_2 supplied and certified in node 1.2.3.1, apply lem-maincb-reset-output-typing alone with D=D_*, t=t_2, epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon, B_R=M_{r+1}, and A_R=A_{U_{r+1}}. Select the single existential output v_{U_{r+1}} of that lemma. Since u_2 is bijective, this same output is an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_R-isomorphism; the same conclusion gives d_{U_{r+1}} <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R, ||v_{U_{r+1}}(I_{M_{r+1}})-u_{A_{U_{r+1}}}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_R, and unchanged source, target, and amplification form. With the recorded field epsilon_{U_{r+1}}:=epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon, these data form the required successor def-maincb-reset-state. No witness from lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation is used or identified with this witness.
